name: tool-approval
title: Tool Approval
usage: <ToolApproval action="Run build" resource="package.json" onDecision={allowed => console.info({ allowed })} />
useCases: Before creating an event, an assistant shows the calendar and proposed action. The user approves or declines, and the app handles the decision.
In a workspace, an agent proposes changing a specific file. The editor checks the resource name before approving the write.
behavior: Supply the action and resource labels. onDecision reports the user choice. The application executes the operation and enforces permissions.
